name: meetings
query: { transcripts(fromDate: "2026-08-03", toDate: "2026-08-08", limit: 50) { id title date duration participants sentences { index speaker_name start_time text } } }
diagnosis: the transcript connector returned nothing. Check the date window first, then whether the connected identity can see other reps' recordings — most conversation-intelligence tools default to private.

name: crm_records
query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, Account.Name, StageName, IsClosed, NextStep, Next_Step_Date__c, Primary_Competitor__c, Identified_Pain__c, Metrics__c, Economic_Buyer__c, Decision_Criteria__c, Decision_Process__c, Paper_Process__c, Champion__c, Decision_Timeline__c, Description, Amount, CloseDate, LastActivityDate FROM Opportunity WHERE Id IN ('0065f00000NW1AAA','0065f00000HG1AAA','0065f00000BP1AAA','0065f00000BP2AAA','0065f00000CV1AAA')
note: Current state of every candidate record, plus existing contact roles.
diagnosis: the integration user cannot read Opportunity, or none of the attendee domains resolve to an account.

name: match_candidates
query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, Account.Name, StageName, IsClosed, LastActivityDate FROM Opportunity WHERE AccountId IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact WHERE Email LIKE '%@northwindanalytics.com' OR Email LIKE '%@heliogrid.io' OR Email LIKE '%@brightpathlabs.com' OR Email LIKE '%@corvuslogistics.com') AND IsClosed = false
diagnosis: no candidates for any meeting — every call will read as unmatched.

name: crm_schema
query: SELECT QualifiedApiName, Label, DataType, IsUpdatable FROM FieldDefinition WHERE EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName IN ('Opportunity','Task','Contact','OpportunityContactRole')
note: Types, updateability and picklist values for every allow-listed field.
diagnosis: no schema captured — picklist and length validation will be skipped.

name: proposals
query: read each transcript, draft values for allow-listed fields only, quote-verbatim required
note: Deliberately includes proposals that must be refused.
diagnosis: Claude drafted nothing. Normal for a short or purely social call.
